title: prunus incisa subsp. kinkiensis
intro: Prunus incisa subsp. kinkiensis, commonly known as Japanese hill cherry or Kinki cherry, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is known for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Prunus incisa subsp. kinkiensis include its ability to reduce anxiety, promote relaxation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
